name: Sandcastle
description: Lightweight ephemeral bwrap filesystem sandbox for OpenClaw agents (secret-path isolation, no Docker).

backend.description: Sandbox backend. 'sandcastle' is the canonical name; 'bwrap' is a deprecated alias (removed in 1.0).

mode.description: Which sessions get sandboxed: off, non-main, or all.

scope.description: Sandbox scope. v1 ships agent + session only (Architecture.md §8).

workspaceAccess.description: Workspace mount mode inside the sandbox.

mapDir.description: Glob map rules: [prefix]<path>[:mode]. + force-allow, - deny (wins). Merged global + per-agent.

env.description: Env schema: true = pass host value, false = strip, string = literal. Unlisted vars are stripped (deny-by-default).
